purpose: Map library neuron populations onto real MaleCNS v1.0 cells and measure the real superclass connectivity backbone, so a declared pathway can be falsified. Presence and non-contradiction only; the declared microcircuit and connection FORM remain literature-derived.

anchored_type_matrix.format: rows[i] = `<col>:<synapses>:<edges>` entries for row type index i, columns ascending; empty string = no measured outgoing synapses

kenyon_cell.note: Kenyon cells: the KCg / KCab / KCa'b' clans, the intrinsic MB cells.

mushroom_body_dan.note: Dopaminergic neurons of the MB: the PAM / PPL / PPM clans.

mushroom_body_apl.note: The single giant GABAergic MB feedback neuron (APL).

antennal_lobe_pn.note: Antennal-lobe projection neurons: adPN / lPN / lvPN / uPN classes.

antennal_lobe_ln.note: Antennal-lobe local neurons, narrowly matched on the unambiguous LNO / GLNO / LN-number classes. Deliberately excludes LNd (a clock group, not an AL LN), so this is a LOWER BOUND on the AL local-neuron population, not the whole class.

central_complex_eb.note: Ellipsoid-body columnar cells (EPG) plus the EL/PEG tangential set.

central_complex_pb.note: Protocerebral-bridge columnar cells: PEN_a/PEN_b and the IB* columnar types.

central_complex_fb.note: Fan-shaped-body columnar cells: PFN/PFNa/PFNd and the FS/FC sets.

central_complex_noduli.note: Noduli cells (Nod1-5) -- the smallest CX neuropil.
central_complex_noduli.caveat: The dataset files Nod1-5 under `visual_projection`, not cb_intrinsic, which is unexpected for CX noduli cells. The match is therefore a NAME match with a possibly wrong dataset label; treat as low confidence.

central_complex_ring.note: Ring neurons of the ellipsoid body: Delta / vDelta / hDelta and the ER series.

clock_neuron_slnv.note: Small ventral lateral clock neurons -- the master pacemaker subset.

descending_neuron.note: Descending neurons (DNg / DNp / DNge / DNpe / DNx) carrying brain output to the VNC. The superclass filter excludes the clock DN1/DN2/DN3 cells and the DNES endocrine cells that share the name prefix.
